# Grid

Responsive CSS grid: columns collapse to one column on small screens, then 2 from sm and the full count from lg. auto fills 16rem tracks.

## Import

```tsx
import { Grid, gridVariants } from "@cesuain/ui";
// or the per-component entry point
import { Grid } from "@cesuain/ui/grid";
```

Props, defaults and live examples are on the Storybook Docs page, generated from the TypeScript types.

## Accessibility

- Behaviour and semantics are summarized above; keyboard and screen reader behaviour follow the WAI-ARIA pattern of the underlying primitive.
- `grid.test.tsx` covers rendering, variants and interaction with Testing Library. Every story also runs axe-core's default rule set in the Storybook browser tests; violations fail the run.
- Colors come from semantic tokens whose contrast is checked in both themes by `pnpm tokens:check`.
